about: Kit 3 sockets, written by kit.py from each character's rest skeleton: px in each template sheet. A part painted into a template keeps these sockets.

pieces.what: head plate, blank: no eyes, brows or mouth painted on (they plug in)
torso: jacket / bodice / dummy chest, neck tab tucked under the head
skirt (the poet only): hangs from the waist, thighs hidden under it
upper arm, left
upper arm, right
forearm with cuff, left
forearm with cuff, right
hand, left: plug-in, 12 shapes x back/palm
hand, right: plug-in
thigh, left: rounded seat end tucks under the hem
thigh, right
shin, left
shin, right
boot / shoe, left: plug-in
boot / shoe, right: plug-in
eyes: plug-in on the eye line (pair, gaze moves the pupils)
brows: plug-in above the eye line
mouth: plug-in at the mouth anchor (expressions and mouth shapes)
sunglasses (the man): plug-in over the eyes, on or off
hair or mark behind the head: the poet's afro back, Dot's bow

man.label: The man
man.look: black track jacket with red piping running from the shoulder seam down the chest, stand-up collar, zip, elastic cuffs and hem; black track trousers with an elastic waist and drawstring; black Chelsea boots; black sunglasses; short faded haircut and full beard; dark brown skin

poet.label: The poet
poet.look: teal dress with a gold floral print, fitted sleeveless bodice and an A-line skirt to the knee; brown arms with a slim gold bangle; full rounded afro; dark brown skin; flat dark teal shoes

dot.label: Dot, the little one
dot.look: a crash-test dummy in mustard-yellow painted cardboard: round head with black-and-yellow crash targets on both sides and a small red bow on top, segmented body with brass brads, red stripe down the chest, mitten hands, flat little feet
